Download a single file from a GitHub repository

download_gh_file.Rd

Looks up a file by path in the GitHub Contents API and downloads it to a local destination using `curl`. A Bearer token is attached automatically when a GitHub PAT is configured (needed for private repositories).

Usage

download_gh_file(
  path,
  dest = path,
  owner = "ofceweb",
  repo = "webblog",
  ref = "site-deploy"
)

Arguments

path

Path to the file inside the repository (e.g. `"posts/2024-01-01/index.qmd"`).

dest

Local path to write the file to. Defaults to `path`.

owner

GitHub user or organisation name. Defaults to `"ofceweb"`.

repo

Repository name. Defaults to `"webblog"`.

ref

Git ref (branch, tag, or SHA). Defaults to `"site-deploy"`.

Value

The local path `dest` on success, or `NULL` if the file was not found in the repository.

Other

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
download_gh_file("posts/my-post/index.qmd", dest = "local/index.qmd")
} # }
